title: EMRS Teaching / Non Teaching Post  Recruitment 2025 Tier-2 Answer Key 2026 Out for 7267 Post
intro: Ek Lavya Model Residential School (EMRS) NESTS  has Officially Released Tier-2 Answer Key for the Post of Principal, TGT, PGT, Staff Nurse (Teaching Post) & Hostel Warden, Accountant, Junior Secretriate Assistant JSA & Lab Attendant (Non Teaching Post) Recruitment 2025 for 7267 Post . Tier-2 Exam held on March 22-25, 2026 & Tier-2 Answer Key Available On  May 12, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Tier-2 Answer Key Now in the Given Link Below.

Principal: The pay is at Level 12, ranging from ₹78,800 to ₹2,09,200.

Post Graduate Teachers (PGTs): The pay is at Level 8, ranging from ₹47,600 to ₹1,51,100. The subjects listed are English, Hindi, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Economics, Biology, History, Geography, Commerce, and Computer Science.

TGTs (Trained Graduate Teachers): The pay is at Level 7, ranging from ₹44,900 to ₹1,42,400. The subjects listed are English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Regional Languages, and Computer Science.
